content:
Who is in the market?

The clinical imaging AI market is well-funded and growing fast. Harrison.ai, Qure.ai, Viz.ai, Brainomix, Lunit, and DeepHealth/Kheiron each hold regulatory clearances and published clinical studies. This post maps the landscape and frames where SEWA fits.

Harrison.ai leads in chest X-ray triage, with FDA clearance and deployment across more than 130 hospitals. Qure.ai has the largest regulatory footprint in tuberculosis screening, with FDA 510(k) clearance for qXR-Detect. Viz.ai dominates large-vessel occlusion detection with its ContaCT platform, reaching over 2,000 hospitals and reporting profitability. Brainomix has published peer-reviewed evidence at scale — its Lancet Digital Health study covered 452,952 patients across 107 NHS hospitals — and is deployed in every English stroke centre.

Lunit holds regulatory clearance in South Korea and the US for lung and breast cancer screening. DeepHealth/Kheiron's GEMINI study, published in Nature Cancer in March 2026, demonstrated a 10.4% increase in cancer detection with over 30% workload reduction.
